remarks: LOOK NO FURTHER! Well kept 1 bedroom apartment for rent in the heart of Norwalk's desirable Union Park. Commuter friendly! Just minutes from I95, Rt7, East Norwalk/South Norwak Train Stations, SONO & MORE! Unit includes 1 spacious bedroom with double closets, open concept living room with plenty of natural light, EIK with full sized pantry & 1 full bath. Recently professionally cleaned & painted! Shared Washer/Dryer in basement - entry to basement next to unit door. Well insulated + newer windows keep the utilities cost LOW! NEWER window units A/C already in place! Parking in rear lot facing Berkeley St. Tenants MUST have good credit, proof of income & references. Owner asking 1 month security deposit, first & last months rent at lease signing. NO PETS/NO SMOKING.
